title: Russia
text: Russia, or the Russian Federation, is a country spanning Eastern Europe and North Asia. It is the largest country in the world by area, covering over 17 million square kilometers. It shares land borders with fourteen countries and has maritime borders with Japan and the United States. Russia is a federal republic comprising eighty-five federal subjects. Its capital and largest city is Moscow. The official language is Russian. Russia was the largest and most influential republic of the Soviet Union until its dissolution in 1991. The country has a vast territory stretching from the Baltic Sea to the Pacific Ocean, with eleven time zones.
